submission.natural_language_explanation: The positive pole fires on a word-internal joiner token - the short token that welds a MODIFIER to the rest of a written unit - and stays at the floor when the same token follows a noun. It peaks on the hyphen of a modifier+head compound (full-time 2.7-3.0, single-photon 2.5-2.7, small-for 2.7, long-term 2.2-2.5, all-day 2.5, four-wheel 2.1-2.4, multi-year 2.0-2.3, two-year 2.1-2.4, wide-ranging 2.5, open-source 2.0, high-risk 1.6-2.0, short-term 1.9-2.0, real-life 2.3-2.5, long-lost 2.2, 100-metre 2.0), on the ordinal or unit suffix after a numeral (3rd 1.8-2.5, 10th 2.0, 500th 2.6-2.8, 3D 2.1-2.5, 4G 1.4), on a decimal point, date slash or time colon between digits (2.5 1.1-1.2, 10/12/1999 2.4, 3/4 2.1, 3:30 1.2), and on the 'and' that coordinates two scalar adjectives (single and multiple 2.8, small and medium 2.2, fast and slow 2.0, third and final 1.8, tall and thin 1.0). The first element decides it: a hyphen after a noun stays at the floor (mother-in-law 0.00, fish-based 0.00, user-friendly 0.00, battery-powered 0.00, brick-built 0.00, government-run 0.00, gas-powered 0.29, part-time 0.31, state-owned 0.05-0.23), 'and' between nouns, verbs or two colours stays at the floor (cat and dog 0.00, men and women 0.00, sang and danced 0.00, red and white 0.20), replacing the joiner with a space or deleting it collapses the peak (full time 0.04, long term 0.00, two year 0.00, 3 rd 0.31, 3 D 0.19, fulltime 0.91 on the word 'time'), and the compound's second element is irrelevant (full-time/full-scale/full-size/full-year all 2.74); ordinary possessives ('a dog's bone' 0.00) and ordinary sentence punctuation never fire. Leftovers outside the claim: the pole also fires at some internal morpheme boundaries of long technical words (tri|peptide 2.3-2.6, auto|stereoscopic 2.3, intra|pulmonary 2.1, nano|structures 2.1-2.2, readt|hedocs 2.1, poly|peptide 1.4-1.5, top|ographic 1.8-2.0) but not others (heter|ogeneity 0.00, path|ological 0.00, under|standing 0.00, organ|ization 0.00), and I have no rule separating the two sets. The mechanism is retrospective: the peak sits on the joiner itself rather than before a predictable token, the Jacobian lens promotes no coherent token set (kurtosis 3.1, 10% agreement with the logit lens), and zero-ablating the pole moves next-token KL by only 8e-4.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Municipal water treatment plants rarely attract public attention until something goes wrong. The facility on the eastern edge of the county has been operating since the late 1970s, and like many plants of its generation it has been retrofitted more times than its original engineers could have imagined. Raw water arrives from two reservoirs through a pair of mains, passes through coarse screens that remove leaves, branches and debris, and then enters a settling basin where suspended solids are allowed to fall out of suspension over several hours. From there the water is dosed with alum and a polymer to encourage the remaining fine particles to clump together into larger flocs, which settle more readily and can be filtered out downstream. Operators watch turbidity readings closely throughout this stage, because a sudden spike can indicate a problem upstream and a slow drift can signal that a dosing pump is failing. The filtration gallery contains eight rapid sand filters arranged in two rows. Each filter is backwashed on a schedule that depends on head loss rather than on elapsed time, although the operators keep a calendar as a backup. A backwash consumes a surprising quantity of treated water, so scheduling decisions have a direct effect on the plant's overall efficiency and on the electricity bill that the county pays each quarter. Disinfection takes place after filtration, in a contact chamber that gives the chlorine enough time to act. The chemistry is delicate. Too little chlorine and harmful organisms survive; too much and the water tastes medicinal, prompting complaints from residents who notice the difference immediately. The staff therefore sample the water at several points along the distribution network every day and adjust the dose by small increments rather than large corrections. Beyond the treatment train itself, the plant maintains its own workshop, laboratory and electrical substation. The laboratory runs membrane filtration tests, cultures for indicator organisms and a range of chemical assays that must be repeated whenever a process change is proposed. The workshop repairs pumps, valves and the high-pressure lines that carry water through the membrane test rig at pressures that would rupture ordinary plumbing. Visitors are often surprised by how much of the building is given over to maintenance rather than to the treatment process itself. Staff training has changed considerably over the decades. Operators once learned their trade on the job, shadowing senior colleagues and reading thick manuals, but licensing requirements now demand formal coursework and periodic examinations. The county has struggled to recruit qualified candidates, partly because salaries have not kept pace with the private sector and partly because the plant sits far from the nearest city. On the night shift a skeleton crew of four is responsible for the entire site, and the supervisor on duty is expected to make decisions that in daylight hours would be shared among engineers, chemists and managers. In the spring of 2019 a storm overwhelmed the drainage around the settling basin and flooded the lower electrical room, which forced the plant onto backup power for three days. The subsequent review recommended raising the electrical equipment above the design flood level and replacing the old diesel generator with a newer unit that could be tested without interrupting treatment. Those recommendations have been only partly implemented, largely because the budget cycle and the political calendar do not align, and the plant continues to operate with a measure of controlled risk that everyone acknowledges but no one enjoys discussing at public meetings.

The first element decides it: a hyphen after a noun stays at the floor (mother-in-law 0.00, fish-based 0.00, user-friendly 0.00, battery-powered 0.00, brick-built 0.00, government-run 0.00, gas-powered 0.29, part-time 0.31, state-owned 0.05-0.23), 'and' between nouns, verbs or two colours stays at the floor (cat and dog 0.00, men and women 0.00, sang and danced 0.00, red and white 0.20), replacing the joiner with a space or deleting it collapses the peak (full time 0.04, long term 0.00, two year 0.00, 3 rd 0.31, 3 D 0.19, fulltime 0.91 on the word 'time'), and the compound's second element is irrelevant (full-time/full-scale/full-size/full-year all 2.74); ordinary possessives ('a dog's bone' 0.00) and ordinary sentence punctuation never fire. Leftovers outside the claim: the pole also fires at some internal morpheme boundaries of long technical words (tri|peptide 2.3-2.6, auto|stereoscopic 2.3, intra|pulmonary 2.1, nano|structures 2.1-2.2, readt|hedocs 2.1, poly|peptide 1.4-1.5, top|ographic 1.8-2.0) but not others (heter|ogeneity 0.00, path|ological 0.00, under|standing 0.00, organ|ization 0.00), and I have no rule separating the two sets. The mechanism is retrospective: the peak sits on the joiner itself rather than before a predictable token, the Jacobian lens promotes no coherent token set (kurtosis 3.1, 10% agreement with the logit lens), and zero-ablating the pole moves next-token KL by only 8e-4.
